name: egrm
description: Build entry point for bench build. frappe/esbuild/esbuild.js runs this package's `build` script for every app that has one, so the grm-portal bundle is produced by `bench build --apps egrm` rather than by hand and committed.

scripts.build: yarn check:strings && yarn --cwd grm-portal install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd grm-portal build
